notes.title: Patch 0.0.0.13
notes.content:
Massive UI Overhaul, new main menu scene, and some other smaller stuff!

Haven't been able to do as much this past month but I'm back working on the game consistently!

Changes:

Massive UI Overhaul

Main Menu

Settings Menu

Dialogue

Multiple CrumpPad Apps

Brand new Main Menu scene

Creatures are now randomized (still working on a better system but for now you get fun creatures!)

Fixed an issue where players couldn't interact with the Gambling Machines

Some lil bug fixes here and there!

notes.title: Patch 0.0.0.12
notes.content:
UI updates and a ton of Bug Fixes :3

Changes:

Revamped dialogue UI! Let me know what you think!
Revamped some other UI elements
Added a Mura wallpaper to the CrumpPad
Fixed bug where Steam name would not show on nametag
Fixed bug where player's creatures would not be deleted when they left the server
Fixed bug where player's cosmetics would stay in the world after leaving server
Fixed overly shiny materials

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.0.11
notes.content:
- Major UI overhaul! Some stuff might not work perfectly yet but so far been liking it! Let me know what you guys think!
- Added a little Mango Carno Creature (can check it out in the dev level)
- Steam Presence should also be working now!

notes.title: Patch 0.0.0.10
notes.content:
HEADS UP: Crump customization may be messed up for you on login if you've customized your Crump already. Just re-customize your Crump or reset them to fix it!

Changes:

- Steam Stats are now functional (Check out the Player Info[ tab in the main menu)
- Added both 50 and 100 player options for Max Players when creating a server (use at ur own risk lmfao)
- Fixed Invisible Crump bug
- Redid how the game connects/communicates with steam
- A billion and 2 bug fixes :3

notes.title: Quick Fix 0.0.0.6b
notes.content:
- Fixed some more controller issues
- Added an SBC wallpaper to the CrumpPad :3

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.0.5
notes.content:
- Fixed Controller Support. Last update messed up controller keybinds but should be fine now!

notes.title: Patch 0.0.0.4 b
notes.content:
More settings yippie!

- Added View Distance Settings

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.0.4
notes.content:
More small QOL changes

New Stuffs

- Added a Koi: FoxFricc hoodie :3
- Added a few customization options hidden behind codes >:)
- Added the ability to set a framerate cap
- Added a "Quick Respawn" button. Hold the button down for a second to respawn at the last checkpoint!
- Edited the audio so it's a little less overwhelming with a lot of Crumps. Sounds should fade out quicker basically!

Bug Fixes:

- Nothing specific just a ton of smol fixes!

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.0.3
notes.content:
Just lil smol update to make the game playable again LOL

New Stuffs

- Added JohnathonFrost as a community
- Added the option to turn On and Off Vsync
- Added a version number in the corner to make it easier to tell what game version you are on

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed a bug where respawning as a client crashed the server
- Fixed a bug where Crumps forgot their spawn point on respawn

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.0.0.2
notes.content:
Hey all! I really appreciate the reception to the game! It means so much to me.

This is a super small update just to fix a few things!

New Stuffs

- Implemented the Tutorials App, where you can find all the tutorials from the game
- Added Cursor images (mouse location should show up on streams now)

Bug Fixes:

- Spawning/Respawning should work much better now! People shouldn't get caught inside things (as much at least)
- Gambling Machines should actually pay you out Rocks now!
- Fixed some incorrect button images (example: Unlock Button)
- Fixed some incorrect spelling in some places lol
